newsitem.title: USA: CBOT corn turns firm, other markets rally further.
newsitem.headline: CBOT corn turns firm, other markets rally further.

text.p: CBOT corn futures turned firm as Cargill bought a total of 17 million bushels and other markets rallied further on strong commercial and fund buying, traders said.
"It looks like this thing is turning around," said Ron Kucha of O'Connor and Co.
Merrill Lynch Futures reportedly bought 3.5 million bushels of soybeans while Refco Inc bought 5 million bushels soybeans, traders said.
In soymeal, Refco Inc was also said to be a buyer of 2,000 lots which further fueled the rally, traders said.
Corn and soybeans had opened lower after USDA raised its U.S. crop production estimates.
At 1248 CST, corn was 1-3/4 cents higher to 1/2 cent lower, with December up 1-3/4 at $2.70 a bushel.
Soybeans were eight to 5-1/4 cents higher, with November up seven at $6.87.
Soymeal was $5.00 to $1.30 higher, with December up $5.00 at $231.70 per ton.
